notes: The page is headed "OFFICIAL RESULTS", run 12/09/22; an ES&S summary report of every contest county-wide, party line by party line, each with a printed Total.

Compiled by the FEC from the states' certified results. The rows for the state and each congressional district, party line by party line (its write-in candidates added into one line). The copy was taken from the one this site fetched for another state.

Linked from the Board's results page (https://www.monroecounty.gov/elections-results); certified fifteenth day of December, two thousand twenty-two. Every contest's lines, Blank, Void, write-ins and a Total in figures and in words.

The certified recap: each Assembly district's figures, party line by party line; the canvassing board's statement is dated Friday, December 2, 2022. The county's row is the sum of its Assembly districts.
A row for each county the contest reaches; compared with each county's own recap.

The Board's own archive of final results (https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/BOE/Election-Results): "Final Results of General Election on Tuesday, November 8, 2022"; one page per group of offices (the list of offices is fingerprinted here); county-wide figures by party line, with no blank, void or scattering figure. Federal contests are compared with the Clerk's certified figures.
